detailed_descriptions_html.en:
Blood Dungeon is a feverish bullet heaven platformer from the creators of Nidhogg. 

Run, jump, and climb to avoid hordes of monsters. Duck and weave between enemies. Scramble up ladders, across grates, and over chains. Walls, ceilings, and even the watery depths are your domains to master.

The dungeons contain over 100 different enemies to kill. Bats. Centaurs. Exploding Eyeballs. Some fly through walls while others walk, stick, or bounce on them. Learn their movements, outsmart them, and harvest their blood.

Increase your blood level to upgrade your build, or find chests hidden throughout the arenas.

Visit the Dogmancer to pay the bone toll and unlock permanent upgrades.

Unlock nine bunkmates, each with their own weapon of choice and movement perks. Spin climbable webs as Leggy, take flight with Bug, or speed through the Dungeons as only a Skinja can. Experiment with them all!

  • 9 unlockable playable characters with different traits and weapons

  • 6 unlockable unique survival arenas

  • Over 100 enemy types

  • Over 100 quests to complete

  • Over 100 unlockable weapons and upgrades

  • Daily dungeons

  • Dynamic “dungeon dnb” soundtrack by Thomas Hoey

  • Global high scores
